title: The DICTO Concordance: A Map and Almanac of the Work, Threads, Names, Concepts, the One Triangle and What Is Missing
description:
This is a map of DICTO's work in one place, so that no detail has to be carried in the head. Threads follow one idea from paper to paper; Names lists every named solid, piece, family and rule with who named it and where it first appears; the Almanac of Concepts says in plain words what each operation, law and method is and where it is used; the last page puts every thread on the one triangle of mirrors. To find anything, look it up in Names or the Almanac and follow the paper numbers.

Version 1 gathers papers #1–#94 of DICTO into 10 threads, 217 names (with who named them and where they first appear), an almanac of 42 concepts, the placement of every thread on the one triangle of mirrors (90°, 60°, 180°/p; 2 cos(180°/p) = 1, √2, φ), and Part 5, What Is Missing: a grid of solids against operations, 15 ranked gaps each paired with outside work, about 40 open points, weak joins, and 34 results from other fields (physics, crystal growth, materials, chemistry, Islamic tilings, music and resonance) with their status from to read to tested.
